{{Quote|It looks shielded, but take a few potshots anyway.|Captain Kael|<ref name="Star Wars: Battle for Naboo" />}}
An attack to '''disrupt''' [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] [[Comm 4|Communications Satellite 4]] occurred during the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Invasion of Naboo]] in [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]]. During the invasion, a group of [[Naboo (people)/Legends|Naboo]] [[Naboo Resistance|resistance]] fighters, led by [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Kael (officer)|Kael]] of [[Bravo Squadron/Legends|Bravo Squadron]], found and saved a [[Nal Raka Criminal Empire|criminal]] [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] named [[Borvo]] the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]]. After they [[Mission to the Naboo mountains|escorted]] him to his mountain [[N-1 assembly site|base]], the Hutt gave the resistance [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]] new [[N-1 starfighter/Legends|fighters]] and intelligence about the invading forces. Together they formed a plan to disrupt the Trade Federation comm web and infiltrate the [[Trade Federation base|base]] it controlled. The Naboo and [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] pilots launched into [[Orbit/Legends|orbit]], where they discovered and destroyed three [[Deflector shield generator/Legends|shield projectors]] protecting Comm 4. They then assaulted the satellite until it exploded, cutting off control to the Trade Federation base.

==Prelude==
[[File:BFN_comm_4_assault.jpg|thumb|left|200px|The assault force, consisting of four N-1 starfighters and one [[Borvo the Hutt's starfighter|other starfighter]] flying up to the target.]]
After facing overwhelming forces in the early stages of the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Invasion of Naboo]] in the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]],<ref name="The New Essential Chronology" /> the [[Royal Naboo Security Forces/Legends|Royal Naboo Security Forces]] were forced to battle for their [[Planet/Legends|planet]]. The Security Force [[Officer/Legends|officers]] [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Kael (officer)|Kael]] and [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Gavyn Sykes/Legends|Gavyn Sykes]] of [[Bravo Squadron/Legends|Bravo Squadron]] joined together and [[Skirmishes in the Naboo countryside|engaged]] [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] forces which were attacking [[Naboo (people)/Legends|Naboo]] civilians. They then joined up with [[Police officer/Legends|police officer]] [[Vedd Deviss]] after protecting his [[Trading village (Naboo swamps)|trading village]]. Acting on intelligence provided by Deviss, the three headed into the northern mountains to [[Mission to the Naboo mountains|search]] for a [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]], [[Borvo]] the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]], who could help them strike back at the [[Trade Federation Droid Army/Legends|Trade Federation Droid Army]]. After Borvo was escorted to the site of his [[Nal Raka Criminal Empire|organization's]] [[N-1 assembly site|base]], the Hutt gave the [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]] new [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]] and vital intelligence with which they used to go back on the offensive against the Trade Federation.<ref name="Star Wars: Battle for Naboo" />

==Orbital battle==
{{Quote|I've found one of the slave satellites, sir. And a minefield!|Lieutenant Sykes, to Captain Kael|<ref name="Star Wars: Battle for Naboo" />}}
[[File:ShieldProjectorComm4.jpg|thumb|right|200px|One of the shield projectors]]
The three Naboo pilots and two of Borvo's pilots flew into [[Orbit/Legends|orbit]] where [[Comm 4]] was located. Once they were near, their [[Sensor/Legends|sensors]] noticed Comm 4 had heavy [[Deflector shield/Legends|shields]], but the pilots took pot shots at the satellite regardless. One of Borvo's pilots, [[Kol Kotha]], suggested the shields were created by three nearby [[Deflector shield generator/Legends|slave satellites]], and Kael ordered them to find and destroy the projectors. Sykes flew toward the first one and discovered the [[Mine/Legends|minefield]] protecting it. Sykes and the other pilots fought through many [[Vulture-class starfighter/Legends|droid starfighters]] and [[Airborne mine|mines]] to knock out the generators one-by-one and expose Comm 4.<ref name="Star Wars: Battle for Naboo" />

After the second projector was destroyed, another of Borvo's pilots, [[Adela Tyché]], who had stayed by the satellite, radioed to say that her shots were starting to affect the shields. Once the shields were down, the pilots moved to attack Comm 4, which still had six [[Missile launcher (Trade Federation)|missile defense turrets]]. A [[Squadron/Legends|squadron]] of droid starfighters also arrived to defend the satellite. Avoiding the [[Missile/Legends|missiles]] and starfighters, the resistance pilots pressed the attack against the satellite and destroyed it, shutting down the control signal to a Federation [[Trade Federation base|base]] down on the planet.<ref name="Star Wars: Battle for Naboo" />

==Aftermath==
{{Quote|Good work people. We just put a Trade Federation base to sleep.|Captain Kael, at the conclusion of the battle|<ref name="Star Wars: Battle for Naboo" />}}
After the satellite blew, Kael congratulated them, and the pilots rejoined formation and flew back down to the surface. The base controlled by the comm satellite became their next [[Attack on disabled base|target]]. They assaulted the base and stole a [[Ostracoda-class gunboat|gunboat]], which Sykes took on the [[Andrevea River]] to [[Liberation of enslavement camps|liberate]] [[Slavery/Legends|slave]] camps full of Naboo [[Prisoner/Legends|prisoners]].<ref name="Star Wars: Battle for Naboo" /> The loss of the station concerned the Trade Federation, and the incident was later mentioned in a report given to the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth Maul/Legends|Darth Maul]] by the leader of the invasion, [[Viceroy of the Trade Federation/Legends|Viceroy]] [[Nute Gunray/Legends|Nute Gunray]].<ref name="EG">{{StoryCite|story=End Game|book=Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace (novelization)|bformatted=''Star Wars'': Episode I ''The Phantom Menace'' novelization, 2012 edition}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The battle appears in the [[2000]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: Episode I: Battle for Naboo]]''.<ref name="Star Wars: Battle for Naboo" /> Unlike the game's predecessor, [[Star Wars: Rogue Squadron (video game)|''Star Wars: Rogue Squadron'']],<ref name="Rogue Squadron game">[[Star Wars: Rogue Squadron (video game)|''Star Wars: Rogue Squadron'']]</ref> this game features several orbital battles such as this, not just on the surface of a moon. If the player is shot down, a short FMV is shown with the fighter plummeting toward the planet.<ref name="Star Wars: Battle for Naboo" />
